figurative_meaning_en: The calamity or trouble is removed or averted
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই অসুবিধাটা চুলোয় যাক, আমরা এখন শান্তিতে থাকি।
পরীক্ষার চাপ চুলোয় গেলে সবকিছু ঠিক হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: May this inconvenience go up in flames, so we can live in peace.
Once the exam pressure is consigned to the flames, everything will be fine.
note: Originates from traditional Bengali household imagery of a clay stove (chulo), symbolizing destruction or removal by fire.
